intro: On your turn (clockwise from Agekeeper), take any actions below in any order, as many times as you like.

children.label: Activate Crucible Card
children.body: Consult your Cauldron Codex for the Formula, assemble the card set in your Spread, discard the set, and drop the Molten Coal into a Cauldron. Flip the Crucible Card face-up — it is now Active.

children.label: Build Astral House
children.body: Pay Planet-matching Common Cards; place 🏰 on a Zodiac Sign. Each House is a permanent Alignment source for every future Harvest.

children.label: Craft Reagent
children.body: Collect suited cards from your Spread and/or Hand whose combined Rank Points meet or exceed your current Cauldron RP Threshold. Discard the cards and take 1 Reagent token.

children.label: Trade
children.body: Freely exchange Kismeta Cards, Reagents, or Active Crucible Cards with any rival. Trading is the only way to transfer Reagents and Active Crucible Cards between players.

gameModeNote.magnus: Misaligned players trade 2:1 in favor of the non-initiating player.

children.label: Duel
children.body: Wager a card from your Spread; roll dice against a rival — winner steals the targeted card from the Defender's Spread.

children.label: Gambit
children.body: Summer only. Show your Spread satisfies a rival's Active Crucible Card Alignment; pay any Ward Reagent entry fee; roll dice — winner swaps the two Active Crucible Cards.
